test_objective: Check that one can delete an attribute from an entity

test_cases.name: 013_01_01 Delete an attribute with the default instance
test_cases.doc: Check that one can delete an attribute from an entity
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Delete Entity Attributes with Response Status Code set to 204     and
        Retrieve Entity by Id with Check Updated Entity and
            Query Parameter: 'updated_resource' set to 'entity_expectation_payload' and
            Query Parameter: 'response_body' set to 'response2.json()' and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to 'ignored_attributes'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}?${params_as_string}'
        method set to 'DELETE'
        Delete Entity Attributes: and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: attributeId set to 'speed' and
    Query Parameter: datasetId set to '${datasetId}' and
    Query Parameter: deleteAll set to '${deleteAll}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://easy-global-market.github.io/ngsild-api-data-models/ngsildTestSuite/ngsildTestSuiteV1.8-compound.jsonld'
}
